display_name: GraniteShares 2x Long SK Hynix Daily ETF

about.en: SKUU is the GraniteShares 2x Long SK Hynix Daily ETF, a leveraged single-stock exchange-traded fund listed on Nasdaq since July 2026 that seeks twice (200%) the daily percentage change of the shares of SK Hynix Inc., the South Korean memory-chip maker, before fees and expenses. Because the leverage resets daily, returns over periods longer than one day can differ substantially from twice the share's performance.
